svg.title: flowchart diagram
svg.desc: A flowchart diagram with 17 nodes and 16 edges. flowing top to bottom. Key nodes: S1 surfaces. kind=tool. Invariant PROJECTED: after L0, command -v ompo first executable is dest or prior, never a third hit. Today installer verifies a supplied absolute path., L0 install, L1 doctor.. Key relationships: S1 surfaces. kind=tool. Invariant PROJECTED: after L0, command -v ompo first executable is dest or prior, never a third hit. Today installer verifies a supplied absolute path. points to L0 install; S1 surfaces. kind=tool. Invariant PROJECTED: after L0, command -v ompo first executable is dest or prior, never a third hit. Today installer verifies a supplied absolute path. points to L1 doctor; S1 surfaces. kind=tool. Invariant PROJECTED: after L0, command -v ompo first executable is dest or prior, never a third hit. Today installer verifies a supplied absolute path. points to L4 swarm.. Layout spans 9148 by 544 units with 17 rendered node boxes and 16 routed edge paths.

g.title: S1 surfaces. kind=tool. Invariant PROJECTED: after L0, command -v ompo first executable is dest or prior, never a third hit. Today installer verifies a supplied absolute path. points to L0 install
S1 surfaces. kind=tool. Invariant PROJECTED: after L0, command -v ompo first executable is dest or prior, never a third hit. Today installer verifies a supplied absolute path. points to L1 doctor
S1 surfaces. kind=tool. Invariant PROJECTED: after L0, command -v ompo first executable is dest or prior, never a third hit. Today installer verifies a supplied absolute path. points to L4 swarm
S1 surfaces. kind=tool. Invariant PROJECTED: after L0, command -v ompo first executable is dest or prior, never a third hit. Today installer verifies a supplied absolute path. points to L5 portal
L0 install points to OMP: none on purpose. Pre-session. omp-rpc-session Command::new omp at lib.rs:136 is the later child, not the installer
L0 install points to NTM: none. No pane yet
L0 install points to Asupersync: subprocess-contract::run_output and Cx, process group kill, drain both pipes. Installer std::process is the current caller to replace
L1 doctor points to OMP: RpcRequest::GetState get_session_stats via omp-rpc-session for OMP children only. omp/18.1.6 --mode=rpc
L1 doctor points to NTM: ntm --robot-snapshot v1.31.0 session presence
L1 doctor points to Asupersync: every probe bounded through run_output. Timeout is RunError::Timeout not a subject verdict. tmux -V not --version
L4 swarm points to OMP: GetState plus GetSessionStats on each OMP pane. Not a spinner regex
L4 swarm points to NTM: ntm spawn --assign --cass-context. WAVE.md from tmux list-panes. Retain spawn response, pane id, WAVE hash, mail register, pack receipt
L4 swarm points to Asupersync: spawn ntm through subprocess-contract and Cx. Same group-kill contract as installer
L5 portal points to OMP: GetState plus GetSessionStats. Does not replace NTM or Agent Mail
L5 portal points to NTM: snapshot plus bv queue as one_next_action input
L5 portal points to Asupersync: portal observe uses Cx checkpoint. No detached poll
